pictures.name: SC1-Patna-River
pictures.prompt: Tall 9:16 contemplative sacred oil painting, lifelike faces, rich textiles, deep blue shadows, warm gold light, main subject in the middle of the frame. No text, letters, logos or modern objects. Morning on wide stone steps leading down to the broad Ganges river at Patna, centuries ago, boats with sails in the haze. A small boy of about five in fine saffron silk and a little wrapped turban, gold bangles on his wrists catching the light, sits safely on a top step with two playmates, seen only from behind, his face never visible. Calm water, gold light, blue mist.

pictures.name: SC2-Bangle-Splash
pictures.prompt: Tall 9:16 contemplative sacred oil painting, lifelike faces, rich textiles, deep blue shadows, warm gold light, main subject in the middle of the frame. No text, letters, logos or modern objects. Close view from behind a small boy in saffron silk and a little wrapped turban sitting safely on a wide stone step above the calm Ganges. His small arm has just tossed a gold bangle, which glints in the air above gentle ripples in the water. His face is never visible. Warm morning gold, deep blue water.

pictures.name: SC3-Mother-Asks
pictures.prompt: Tall 9:16 contemplative sacred oil painting, lifelike faces, rich textiles, deep blue shadows, warm gold light, main subject in the middle of the frame. No text, letters, logos or modern objects. On the stone river steps, a gentle young mother in a pale cream head-covering and simple embroidered clothes kneels beside her small son, one hand on his shoulder, looking at the water with loving worry. The small boy in saffron silk and a little wrapped turban is seen only from behind. Calm Ganges, soft morning light.

pictures.name: SC4-Second-Bangle
pictures.prompt: Tall 9:16 contemplative sacred oil painting, lifelike faces, rich textiles, deep blue shadows, warm gold light, main subject in the middle of the frame. No text, letters, logos or modern objects. The same river steps. The gentle young mother in a pale cream head-covering sits back in surprise, half-smiling, as a second gold bangle flies from the small boy’s hand into the calm river with a tiny splash. The boy in saffron silk is seen only from behind. Two attendants in white look on, amazed. Gold light on the ripples.

pictures.name: SC5-Crowns-For-All
pictures.prompt: Tall 9:16 contemplative sacred oil painting, lifelike faces, rich textiles, deep blue shadows, warm gold light, main subject in the middle of the frame. No text, letters, logos or modern objects. The green hills of Anandpur in old Punjab, late afternoon. A crowd of ordinary Sikh men of many trades, farmers, a barber, a water-carrier, a cloth dyer, stand tall in freshly tied turbans of many colors, plain steel bracelets on their wrists, dignified like kings. Far away on a hilltop, small and seen from behind, a figure in royal blue with a tall turban watches over them. Rich textiles, gold light.

pictures.name: SC6-Today-Mirror
pictures.prompt: Tall 9:16 contemplative oil painting in the same sacred style (lifelike faces, rich textiles, deep blue shadows, warm gold light), a modern scene, main subject in the middle. No text, letters or logos. A modern bedroom in early morning light. A young Sikh man with a neat dark beard stands at a mirror tying a long deep-maroon turban cloth, fold by fold, over his hair, the cloth stretched between his hands; a plain steel kara on his wrist. A school backpack and phone on the bed. Calm, quiet pride.
